purpose: Independent practice of D2.1 likelihood vocabulary.

header.character_watermark: Lucky Lou the Loon in the top-right with a magnifying glass. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Read each event. Circle I (impossible), P (possible), or C (certain).
parts.visual_layout: 6 event rows with I/P/C circles to circle.

image_placeholders.description: Six event rows for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Each row has an event and 3 letter circles I/P/C. Events: 'Pig flies', 'Sun rises', 'Rain at recess', 'I will turn 100', 'A friend smiles', 'Snow in July in Toronto'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P1_EVENTS at Part 1: keywords name the categories.

parts.answer_key: I, C, P, I, P, I.

parts.student_instructions: Write a prediction about TODAY using a likelihood word.

image_placeholders.description: A bordered writing box for a Grade 2 worksheet, ~5in × 1.5in. Above: 'My prediction:'. Below the box, sentence-frame reminder: 'It is ___ that ___.'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P2_BOX at Part 2: keyword names the activity.

parts.answer_key: Any prediction using a likelihood word.

image_placeholders.description: Three labelled writing lines for a Grade 2 worksheet. 'IMPOSSIBLE: ___', 'POSSIBLE: ___', 'CERTAIN: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P3_LINES at Part 3: keywords name the categories.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, draw an IMPOSSIBLE event.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Use Part 1 for diagnostic. Part 1 includes a 'Lucky vs Mae disagree' format — children justify which character is right with cause-effect reasoning. Verifies generalisation beyond the rehearsed examples.
